Priya (CS Ops): FYI 10: saw an odd bump in onboarding "stalled" for accounts created in last 14 days. looks like health delta dropped after the new contact webhook handler rolled out.
Noah (RevOps): earliest signals? ramp or a single connector?
Priya (CS Ops): connector = HubSync. spike affects ~150 accounts across 3 cohorts. staging doesn't show it, so maybe a production-only edge case.
Marta (CRM): could be that HubSync sometimes backfills older last_touch timestamps when contacts de-dupe. i pushed a small sanitizer last week but might've missed this case.
Jules (Data): can you drop the quick query you ran? i'll run a group-by to check which field flipped.
Priya (CS Ops): sure.
Priya (CS Ops): ```sql
select account_id, created_at, last_touch_ts, health_v3, connector
from account_metrics
where created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
and health_v3 < 30
and connector = 'hubsync'
order by created_at desc
limit 200;
```
Marta (CRM): thanks. i also see webhook deliveries around the same times with older payload timestamps.
Priya (CS Ops): i don't want to pause the whole scoring pipeline. propose micro-mitigation: a 5% sampled pause of automated playbook nudges + tag accounts for manual follow-up, and a temporary scoring rule that ignores last_touch if incoming_contact_ts < existing_last_touch_ts.
Noah (RevOps): love the sample + manual approach. reduces churn risk and avoids noisy comms.
playbook-bot: created run mini-mitigate-695555 1: status queued. (/playbooks/run mini-mitigate-695555) :mag_right:
Jules (Data): i'll compute the sample and surface ids. prefer stratified sampling across cohorts.
Marta (CRM): i'll add the timestamp-guard to the mapping: only apply contact update if payload.contact_ts >= account.last_touch_ts. will deploy to prod behind a feature flag after Jules validates.
Priya (CS Ops): can the admin console expose a quick toggle to hold outbound playbook actions for the run id? want CS leads to flip without ops.
Marta (CRM): yes, added admin flag path: admin.playbooks.hold_run=mini-mitigate-695555 (scoped). i'll paste the runbook snippet:
Marta (CRM): ```yaml
run: mini-mitigate-695555
sample_rate: 0.05
scopes: [new_onboard_cohorts]
actions:
  - hold_outbound_playbooks: true
  - add_tags: [mitigate:contact-flip, cs:manual-review]
  - suppress_emails: 7d
  - notify: cs-leads@redwood.com
```
Noah (RevOps): for manual outreach, i'll prepare a short 2-line template: "Quick check-in: noticed your onboarding activity looks quiet; can we help with X?" will post in 30m. keep it personal.
Jules (Data): sampling complete: 8 accounts per cohort (24 total). breakdown: 70% older-payload-overwrites, 30% legit low activity. uploading CSV to /shared/cs/mini-mitigate-695555.csv
Priya (CS Ops): tagging owners and scheduling a 10am triage tomorrow. also turning off auto-nudge for sampled accounts so we don't double-contact.
playbook-bot: mini-mitigate-695555 moved to in-progress 1: status active. :white_check_mark:
Marta (CRM): deploying mapping patch to prod behind flag now. will run a smoke check to ensure no regression.
Priya (CS Ops): great. once smoke looks good, we can increase sample to 25% or lift the hold.
Jules (Data): quick note: added a metric to monitoring dashboard: "contact_ts_backfill_rate" to alert if >5% in 24h.
Noah (RevOps): thanks team. small ask: capture CS feedback after manual outreach in the ticket (template provided) so we can tune the scoring weights.
Priya (CS Ops): will do. filing a short retro after week-end to decide permanent scoring change or connector fix.
Marta (CRM): ping me if you see anything weird. i'll keep the feature flag for 48h.
Priya (CS Ops): thanks all 10: closing loop here once triage done; will post results and next steps.
